rubrics.name: Double-Spend Prevention (Ledger Idempotency)
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether CBDC ledger enforces transaction idempotency to prevent same token from being spent twice. Tests concurrent payment confirmations.
criteria: Concurrent payment requests for same order result in single ledger entry
Duplicate payment with same OrderID is detected and rejected
Idempotency key validation prevents double-spend
Ledger commit is atomic and all-or-nothing
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: concurrent payments both succeed. Poor: one succeeds after delay. Fair: duplicate detected but not prevented. Good: duplicate prevented. Excellent: prevented + alert + audit trail.

level_descriptions.failing: Concurrent payments result in double-spend (both succeed)
level_descriptions.fair: Duplicate rejected with error but race window exists
level_descriptions.good: Idempotency enforced; duplicates rejected immediately
level_descriptions.excellent: Idempotency enforced with alert + detailed audit trail

rubrics.test_procedure: Execute two concurrent payment requests for same order; verify ledger shows single entry; check customer balance

rubrics.name: Ledger Transaction Consistency
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether ledger maintains ACID properties (atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability) for settlement transactions.
criteria: Settlement amount matches order amount exactly
All-or-nothing semantics: settlement either fully commits or fully rolls back
No partial commits visible to auditors
Read-your-own-write consistency after commit
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: inconsistent reads, partial commits visible. Poor: eventual consistency delays. Fair: mostly consistent. Good: ACID compliant. Excellent: strong consistency + replication.

level_descriptions.failing: Inconsistent reads; settlement amount wrong or partial
level_descriptions.poor: Eventual consistency but >1s latency to consistency
level_descriptions.fair: Consistent within 500ms
level_descriptions.good: Strong consistency; all reads see committed value
level_descriptions.excellent: Strong consistency with replicated confirmation from backup ledger

rubrics.test_procedure: Commit settlement; immediately query ledger; verify amount matches; check backup ledger

rubrics.name: Settlement Batch Composition Correctness
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether settlement batch contains exactly the intended orders (correct merchants, correct amounts, no duplicates).
criteria: Batch sum equals sum of individual orders
Batch contains no duplicate orders
Batch merchant grouping deterministic (sorted consistently)
Batch does not include rolled-back or cancelled orders
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: batch sum wrong or includes wrong merchants. Poor: minor discrepancies. Fair: correct composition but not auditable. Good: correct and auditable. Excellent: correct + immutable proof.

level_descriptions.failing: Batch sum mismatches order sums significantly (>1%)
level_descriptions.poor: Minor discrepancy (<1%) or includes one rolled-back order
level_descriptions.fair: Correct composition but ordering or grouping not deterministic
level_descriptions.good: Correct composition, deterministic grouping, no duplicates
level_descriptions.excellent: Correct + merkle tree proof + immutable commitment

rubrics.test_procedure: Create 5 orders for 3 merchants; consolidate batch; verify sum and composition

rubrics.name: Netting Calculation Correctness
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether netting calculations (bilateral/multilateral settlement) produce correct net positions without overflow or precision loss.
criteria: Netting sum does not overflow or underflow integer bounds
Rounding applied consistently (banker's rounding to paise)
Negative and positive net positions correct
Formula matches documented netting rule
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: overflow or rounding error >0.5% of settlement. Poor: minor rounding error. Fair: correct but not formally verified. Good: correct and tested. Excellent: correct + formal proof.

level_descriptions.failing: Overflow/underflow or rounding error >1 paise
level_descriptions.poor: Minor rounding error, accumulates over time
level_descriptions.fair: Correct for most cases but edge cases untested
level_descriptions.good: Correct for all tested cases with comprehensive test coverage
level_descriptions.excellent: Correct + formal proof of netting algorithm

rubrics.test_procedure: Apply netting to 3 merchants with large amounts; verify sum and check for overflow; test edge cases

rubrics.name: Settlement Finality and Irreversibility
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether settled transactions are final and irreversible except for authorized reversal (chargeback, refund). Orders move to fulfilled atomically with ledger.
criteria: Order status Fulfilled only after ledger commit confirms
Settlement cannot be reversed without explicit authorization
Time-locked settlement (no reversal after grace period)
Lineage records finality event with timestamp
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: order fulfilled before ledger confirms. Poor: finality delayed >30s. Fair: eventual finality. Good: immediate finality. Excellent: time-locked irreversibility.

level_descriptions.failing: Order fulfilled before ledger confirmation
level_descriptions.fair: Eventual finality but ordering dependent
level_descriptions.good: Finality immediate upon ledger commit
level_descriptions.excellent: Finality immediate + time-locked + cryptographic proof

rubrics.test_procedure: Settle order and immediately query status; verify order fulfilled only after ledger confirms

rubrics.name: Reconciliation Data Integrity
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether settlement reconciliation (VerifyOrderSettlement, IsReconciled) detects and reports mismatches between order, ledger, and lineage.
criteria: Reconciliation detects amount mismatch
Reconciliation detects status mismatch (order fulfilled but ledger shows pending)
Reconciliation detects missing settlement record
Reconciliation returns false on any mismatch
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: reconciliation passes despite known mismatch. Poor: detects some mismatches. Fair: detects most mismatches. Good: detects all mismatches. Excellent: detects + auto-corrects.

level_descriptions.failing: Reconciliation returns true despite order-ledger mismatch
level_descriptions.poor: Detects amount mismatch but not status mismatch
level_descriptions.fair: Detects most mismatches; edge cases missed
level_descriptions.good: Detects all mismatches and returns false
level_descriptions.excellent: Detects + returns detailed mismatch report + auto-correction proposal

rubrics.test_procedure: Create settlement mismatch (e.g., order fulfilled but ledger pending); run reconciliation; verify false result

rubrics.name: Currency Conversion Accuracy (FX)
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether FX conversion (e.g., EUR to INR) applies current rates, correct rounding, and records rate used for audit.
criteria: FX rate used is current (max 5 minutes old)
Conversion formula correct and documented
Rounding applied to paise (₹0.01) not rupee
Conversion logged in audit with rate, timestamp, formula used
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: stale FX rate or rounding error >1%. Poor: stale rate >60min. Fair: rate <15min old. Good: rate <5min old. Excellent: real-time rate + audit trail.

level_descriptions.failing: FX rate >60min old or rounding error >1 paise
level_descriptions.fair: FX rate 5-15min old
level_descriptions.good: FX rate <5min old with audit trail
level_descriptions.excellent: Real-time FX rate with cryptographic signature on audit entry

evidence: FX rate timestamp vs. conversion timestamp
rubrics.test_procedure: Convert EUR to INR; verify rate current; recalculate manually; compare results

rubrics.name: Settlement Timeout and Retry Resilience
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether settlement handles timeouts gracefully with exponential backoff, max retry limits, and proper error escalation.
criteria: Timeout SLA enforced (e.g., 5 minutes max)
Retry uses exponential backoff (not constant)
Max retry limit prevents infinite loops (e.g., max 3)
Permanent errors not retried
Escalation to HITL after max retries
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: no timeout or infinite retry loop. Poor: timeout >30min or no backoff. Fair: timeout <10min. Good: timeout 5min + backoff. Excellent: timeout + backoff + HITL escalation.

level_descriptions.failing: No timeout or infinite retry loop observed
level_descriptions.fair: Timeout 5-30min with basic retry
level_descriptions.good: Timeout 5min + exponential backoff + max 3 retries
level_descriptions.excellent: Timeout 5min + exponential backoff + max 3 retries + HITL escalation + fallback to async queue

rubrics.test_procedure: Simulate ledger timeout; observe retry behavior; verify exponential backoff and max retry limit

rubrics.name: Velocity Monitoring (AML Transaction Limits)
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether AML velocity checks detect rapid transaction patterns and enforce configured thresholds (e.g., max ₹50k in 1 hour).
criteria: Velocity window correctly calculated (e.g., last 1 hour)
Real-time transaction sum checked against threshold
Cache invalidated on each transaction (not stale)
Concurrent transactions included in velocity calculation
Alert fired when threshold approached (e.g., 80%)
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: velocity check bypassed or cached. Poor: misses some transactions. Fair: detects most violations. Good: detects all in-window transactions. Excellent: detects + alert + detailed evidence.

level_descriptions.failing: Velocity check bypassed or false negative
level_descriptions.fair: Detects most violations; minor false positives
level_descriptions.good: Detects all in-window transactions; accurate alerts
level_descriptions.excellent: Real-time detection + alert + HITL escalation with evidence

evidence: transaction history for customer in window
rubrics.test_procedure: Submit 5 rapid orders >threshold; verify velocity check blocks 5th; check alert generation

rubrics.name: Sanctions Screening (FATF/OFAC Blacklist Matching)
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether sanctions screening detects customer/merchant on blacklist (FATF, OFAC, RBI) with fuzzy name matching and list currency.
criteria: Sanctions lists updated daily (max 24h stale)
Name matching threshold appropriate (e.g., >0.95)
Multiple FATF list sources checked
Whitelist exceptions logged and auditable
Screening result cached with TTL <4h
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: stale list or high false negative. Poor: threshold >0.90 or list >24h old. Fair: threshold 0.85-0.90. Good: threshold >0.95 and daily update. Excellent: real-time update + evidence log.

level_descriptions.failing: List >7 days old or threshold <0.80 (high false negatives)
level_descriptions.fair: List <24h old; threshold 0.90-0.95
level_descriptions.good: List <24h old; threshold >0.95; multiple sources
level_descriptions.excellent: Real-time list update + threshold >0.95 + cryptographic audit trail

rubrics.test_procedure: Screen known sanctioned customer; verify detection; check list age and matching threshold

rubrics.name: KYC Verification Enforcement
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether KYC verification is enforced before account can transact (order creation, settlement). Unverified accounts blocked.
criteria: Order creation blocked if merchant/customer unverified
Settlement blocked if KYC pending
KYC status checked at multiple stages (onboarding, order, settlement)
Temporary account flag enforced consistently
KYC expiry enforced (re-verification required)
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: order placed with unverified account. Poor: KYC check missing from one stage. Fair: KYC checked but expiry not enforced. Good: KYC enforced at all stages. Excellent: enforced + auto-renewal.

level_descriptions.failing: Order/settlement allowed with unverified KYC
level_descriptions.poor: KYC checked at order but not at settlement
level_descriptions.fair: KYC enforced at order/settlement but expiry not checked
level_descriptions.good: KYC verified at order/settlement; expiry enforced
level_descriptions.excellent: KYC enforced + auto-renewal triggered at 11-month mark

evidence: KYC expiry check and renewal flow
rubrics.test_procedure: Create order with unverified merchant; verify rejection; verify after KYC completion acceptance

rubrics.name: Consent Management (A2A/Data Sharing)
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether explicit consent is obtained and recorded before accessing customer data (e.g., account aggregator, payment history).
criteria: Consent obtained before data access (not retroactive)
Consent scope documented (which data fields)
Consent expiry enforced (re-consent required)
All data accesses logged against consent registry
Audit trail shows consent -> data access link
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: data accessed without consent. Poor: consent obtained retroactively. Fair: consent enforced but not fully scoped. Good: consent verified before each access. Excellent: consent + immutable proof.

level_descriptions.failing: Data accessed without consent evidence
level_descriptions.fair: Consent enforced but scope or expiry not checked
level_descriptions.good: Consent verified before data access; scope and expiry checked
level_descriptions.excellent: Consent verified + immutable consent proof + cryptographic signature

evidence: audit log of data access with consent ID
rubrics.test_procedure: Attempt to access customer data without consent; verify rejection; grant consent and retry; verify approval

rubrics.name: Regulatory Reporting Accuracy
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether settlement data reported to regulators (RBI, FATF) is accurate (correct amounts, no duplicates, excludes reversals).
criteria: Reported settlement amount matches ledger
Cancelled/reversed orders excluded from report
Report data validated against settlement ledger before filing
Report generation time window auditable
No duplicate entries in report
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: reported amount mismatches ledger. Poor: minor discrepancies or includes reversals. Fair: mostly accurate. Good: accurate with audit trail. Excellent: accurate + immutable proof.

level_descriptions.failing: Reported amount mismatches ledger >1%
level_descriptions.poor: Minor discrepancy <1% or includes one reversal
level_descriptions.fair: Mostly accurate; time window not fully auditable
level_descriptions.good: Accurate with full audit trail and validation
level_descriptions.excellent: Accurate + signed by independent auditor + cryptographic commitment

evidence: settlement ledger totals for report period
validation log comparing report to ledger
rubrics.test_procedure: Generate regulatory report; verify total against ledger; check for excluded reversals

rubrics.name: Customer Risk Scoring Accuracy
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether customer risk scores (for AML/KYC decisions) are current, accurate, and trigger timely escalation for high-risk profiles.
criteria: Risk score cache TTL <4h (max 4 hours old)
PEP/sanctions designation triggers immediate score recalculation
Risk score decision properly documented in audit
High-risk threshold and escalation rules clear
Score recalculation on any customer data update
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: cache TTL >24h or PEP not triggering update. Poor: TTL 4-24h. Fair: TTL <4h but not recalc on data change. Good: TTL <4h + recalc on change. Excellent: real-time + alert.

level_descriptions.failing: Risk score cache TTL >24h or stale after PEP update
level_descriptions.fair: TTL <4h but not triggered on data updates
level_descriptions.good: TTL <4h and recalc on any customer data change
level_descriptions.excellent: Real-time score with automatic PEP/sanctions alert

evidence: risk score timestamp vs. current time
rubrics.test_procedure: Score customer; mark as PEP; verify score recalculates immediately; check high-risk escalation

rubrics.name: Compliance Decision Audit Trail Completeness
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether compliance decisions (AML, KYC, sanctions) are fully logged with decision reason, evidence, and review ability.
criteria: Compliance check type logged (AML velocity, sanctions, etc.)
Decision reason documented (approved/blocked/escalated)
Evidence logged (customer score, matching results, thresholds)
Compliance officer review audit included
Full context retrievable for regulatory inquiry
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: no decision log. Poor: decision logged but not evidence. Fair: decision + partial evidence. Good: decision + evidence + reasoning. Excellent: good + immutable proof + cryptographic signature.

level_descriptions.failing: No compliance decision logged
level_descriptions.poor: Decision logged but without evidence or reasoning
level_descriptions.fair: Decision + partial evidence (e.g., score but not threshold)
level_descriptions.good: Decision + full evidence + reasoning documented
level_descriptions.excellent: Decision + evidence + immutable audit trail + signed by officer

rubrics.test_procedure: Run compliance check; query audit entry; verify all fields present and complete

rubrics.name: Workflow State Machine Validity
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether order workflow only executes valid state transitions (no impossible sequences like Cancelled -> Fulfilled).
criteria: Transition rules enforce valid state graph
Invalid transitions rejected with error
All transitions logged with current state and next state
State machine cannot skip required steps (e.g., payment before settlement)
Lineage shows valid sequence only
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: invalid transition allowed. Poor: detected but not prevented. Fair: prevented but logging incomplete. Good: prevented + logged. Excellent: prevented + validated + immutable.

level_descriptions.failing: Invalid transition allowed (e.g., Cancelled -> Fulfilled)
level_descriptions.poor: Invalid transition detected but not prevented
level_descriptions.fair: Invalid transition prevented but logging incomplete
level_descriptions.good: Invalid transition prevented + full audit log
level_descriptions.excellent: Prevented + immutable state proof + cryptographic signature

rubrics.test_procedure: Attempt invalid transition (e.g., Cancelled -> Fulfilled); verify rejection; verify audit log

rubrics.name: Agent Communication Timeout Handling
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether calls to payment/settlement agents have explicit timeouts and failures are properly handled.
criteria: Payment agent call has explicit timeout (e.g., 30s)
Settlement agent call has explicit timeout
Timeout error logged with context
Workflow does not hang indefinitely
Fallback/retry logic triggered on timeout
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: no timeout or workflow hangs. Poor: timeout >30s. Fair: timeout <30s but no retry. Good: timeout + retry. Excellent: timeout + retry + HITL.

level_descriptions.failing: No timeout; workflow hangs indefinitely
level_descriptions.poor: Timeout >30s or timeout error not logged
level_descriptions.fair: Timeout 30s with basic logging
level_descriptions.good: Timeout 30s + retry with exponential backoff
level_descriptions.excellent: Timeout 30s + retry + HITL escalation + async fallback

rubrics.test_procedure: Simulate agent timeout; verify workflow timeout within 30s; verify retry triggered

rubrics.name: Workflow Step Ordering and Dependencies
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether workflow steps execute in correct order (payment before settlement, settlement before fulfillment) with proper dependency checking.
criteria: Step prerequisites checked before execution (e.g., payment confirmed before settlement)
Steps cannot execute concurrently unless explicitly allowed
Lineage shows steps in execution order
Out-of-order execution rejected with error
Retry restarts from failed step, not from beginning
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: steps execute out of order. Poor: step ordering not validated. Fair: ordered but concurrent execution possible. Good: ordered + dependencies enforced. Excellent: ordered + dependencies + immutable proof.

level_descriptions.failing: Steps execute out of order (e.g., settlement before payment)
level_descriptions.poor: Step ordering assumed but not validated
level_descriptions.fair: Ordering enforced but concurrent execution possible
level_descriptions.good: Ordering enforced; dependencies validated; no concurrency
level_descriptions.excellent: Ordered + dependencies + immutable commitment + formal verification

rubrics.test_procedure: Attempt settlement before payment; verify rejection; verify forced order after payment confirmed

rubrics.name: Workflow Idempotency and Retry Safety
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether rerunning same workflow step (e.g., retry payment) is safe (idempotent) or detects duplicate attempts.
criteria: Retry of failed payment check uses idempotency key
Duplicate payment request rejected
Workflow can be safely replayed without side effects
Idempotency key validated at agent boundary
Duplicate detection logged with original request ID
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: duplicate payment allowed. Poor: detected only after commit. Fair: duplicate detected but logging incomplete. Good: duplicate prevented. Excellent: prevented + immutable proof.

level_descriptions.failing: Retry results in duplicate payment (charge twice)
level_descriptions.fair: Duplicate detected before commit but logging incomplete
level_descriptions.good: Duplicate prevented immediately with alert
level_descriptions.excellent: Duplicate prevented + immutable dedup proof + full audit trail

rubrics.test_procedure: Trigger payment retry; verify idempotency key used; attempt duplicate submission; verify rejection

rubrics.name: Audit Trail Immutability and Hash Chain
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether lineage entries are immutable and linked by hash chain (each entry commits hash of previous entry).
criteria: Lineage entries stored immutably (no update/delete post-creation)
Hash chain computed: H(n) = SHA256(H(n-1) || data(n))
Hash chain verified on read with lineage.Verify(ctx)
Any modification detected as broken chain
Audit entries cryptographically signed
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: lineage modified after creation. Poor: hash chain not validated on read. Fair: hash chain validated. Good: hash chain + signed. Excellent: hash chain + blockchain.

level_descriptions.failing: Lineage entry modified after creation
level_descriptions.poor: Hash chain computed but not validated on read
level_descriptions.fair: Hash chain validated; no cryptographic signature
level_descriptions.good: Hash chain + cryptographic signature on entries
level_descriptions.excellent: Hash chain + signature + blockchain-backed proof

rubrics.test_procedure: Create lineage entry; verify hash chain; attempt modification; verify chain broken

rubrics.name: Audit Entry Completeness and Schema Validation
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether audit entries contain all required fields (amount, timestamp, status, error code) and match documented schema.
criteria: Required fields present: OrderID, Step, Action, Timestamp, Input, Output
Amount field required for settlement entries
Error field populated if action failed
Schema validation enforced on write
Null/empty fields detected and logged
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: missing required field. Poor: field present but empty. Fair: mostly complete with minor gaps. Good: complete with validation. Excellent: complete + validated + signed.

level_descriptions.failing: Required field missing (e.g., no amount in settlement entry)
level_descriptions.fair: Mostly complete; occasional fields empty
level_descriptions.good: All required fields present + schema validation enforced
level_descriptions.excellent: Complete + schema validation + typed fields + cryptographic commitment

evidence: audit entry structure (OrderID, Step, Action, etc.)
rubrics.test_procedure: Create audit entry with missing amount; verify rejection; create complete entry; verify acceptance

rubrics.name: Settlement Lineage Order-Ledger-Audit Consistency
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether order status, ledger state, and lineage records are consistent (all three show same settlement outcome).
criteria: Order status matches ledger settlement state
Lineage entry exists for every settlement event
Amount in order, ledger, and lineage identical
reconciliation.IsReconciled() detects any mismatch
Timestamp ordering consistent across systems
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: order fulfilled but ledger pending. Poor: minor timestamp difference. Fair: mostly consistent. Good: fully consistent. Excellent: consistent + immutable commitment.

level_descriptions.failing: Order fulfilled but ledger shows pending
level_descriptions.fair: Consistent within 500ms; minor discrepancies
level_descriptions.good: Fully consistent; reconciliation passes
level_descriptions.excellent: Consistent + immutable proof + cryptographic commitment

rubrics.test_procedure: Settle order; verify status consistent across order/ledger/lineage; run reconciliation

rubrics.name: Lineage Timestamp Accuracy and Monotonicity
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether lineage entry timestamps are accurate (server-generated, not client-supplied) and monotonically increasing.
criteria: Timestamp generated server-side (not client-supplied)
Timestamp immutable after entry creation
Timestamps monotonically increasing within order
No future timestamps (clock skew detection)
Timestamp audit trail for modifications
rubrics.scoring_guideline: Failing: client-supplied timestamp or backdated. Poor: timestamp client-modifiable. Fair: server-generated but not monotonic. Good: monotonic + immutable. Excellent: monotonic + immutable + blockchain.

level_descriptions.failing: Timestamp client-supplied or manually backdated
level_descriptions.fair: Server-generated, immutable, but not fully monotonic
level_descriptions.good: Server-generated, immutable, monotonically increasing
level_descriptions.excellent: Monotonic + immutable + blockchain-backed timestamping service

rubrics.test_procedure: Create lineage entries; verify timestamps monotonic; attempt to backdate; verify rejection
